author: Miles_Brundage
text: @GaryMarcus @jacobaustin132 @OpenAI With lots of caveats ofc (benchmarks imperfect etc.), one can compare "pure" LMs to LMs + other things, or entirely different techniques on things like TruthfulQA. author: Miles_Brundage
text: @jacobaustin132 @GaryMarcus @OpenAI Wasn't saying honesty or anything else had been totally solved, just pointing towards some frameworks for measuring progress since I expected that might be your follow-up Q :) IMO helpfulness is the area the most progress has been made so far

author: Miles_Brundage
text: @GaryMarcus @OpenAI (there isn't a clear/single metric for progress--the closest is prob. multidimensional frameworks like helpfulness/harmlessness/honesty + various ad hoc measures thereof--but certainly those represent more effort at explicitly steering values than any multimodal stuff I've seen)

author: Miles_Brundage
text: @GaryMarcus @OpenAI Note that DALL-E 2 is SOTA in some dimensions of generative capabilities but not SOTA w.r.t. "building values into machines."
